text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Among the roster for the Japan Cup are Zenno Rob Roy and Special Week, both of who have returned to racing after a long hiatus.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Both are top-tier racers—but that is within expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd awaits with bated breath, anticipating a fierce battle ahead. Meanwhile, Eishin Flash maintains a confident resolve.
